Chapter 1
The ferry came at noon, as it always did, and Mara watched it cross the grey water from the lamp room.
“Late again,” she said to nobody — the gulls didn’t care.
Her father was asleep below.
***
By evening the wind had turned.
She lit the lamp at six.
Chapter 2
The letter arrived on a Tuesday.
It was addressed to her mother, who had been dead for eleven years.
She burned it in the stove.
Chapter 3
Spring came late to the island.
Mara counted the boats.
